title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: After receiving the court notice, Anbu desperately tries to convince Kanmani to reconsider the divorce. Refusing to give up, he stays outside her house despite her rejection.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Viji showers Paraman with motherly affection by serving him food. Kalamma refuses Ilamathi's help and assigns Nurse Nalani to treat Paraman's injury.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna suspects Abinaya is Sudar's mom and follows her. Shanmugam gets emotional talking to Sudar, while Divakar reveals Sudar's true identity and tells Karna to stay calm.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: To humiliate Mayandi's family by avoiding the wedding ceremony, Poongodi heads to Selvi's house. Pechi grows suspicious when Manjamalai fails to get ready for the celebration.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: A grateful Gayathri regains her voice after Sindhu saves her. Overjoyed, Sindhu accepts Annapurani's invitation and happily attends Gayathri's wedding with Siva.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj grows suspicious of Revathi's frequent calls after hearing about an acquaintance's wife eloping. Malar confesses to Bagyaraj about their private family gossip group.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Both families celebrate the happy news of Raji's pregnancy. Meanwhile, Raji grows tense because her pregnancy is not yet confirmed, prompting her to demand a test at the hospital.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pandian excitedly gets Vannathi's scooter ready as a surprise. His joy fades when she arrives on Aravind's scooter, explaining that she bought it from him.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi tricks Sivagami into laying the first brick in the room. Sathya and Rekha visit their sick dad, while Seetha suspects Sinthamani's motives.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Rajangam saves Sethupathi from goons. Meenatchi's tumble delights Sethupathi, while Eshwari discusses Aishwarya's hurdles and asks Sethupathi to care for her.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya's emotional plea convinces Arjun to return home after he refuses. Kasthuri is heartbroken when Jaganathan arranges her marriage to Maran despite her love for Karthik.
